note: Flap custom-vault side only. No token has been launched; a token is created by Flap's launcher through the VaultPortal.
beaconOwnerIs: Flap Guardian (BNB Chain), set in LeverBeacon's constructor -- never the deployer

supersedes.reason: Flap's reviewer asked that every module beyond the vault itself also be upgradeable, so the Guardian can rescue all of them. The factory was immutable: it held the beacon as an `immutable` and created it in its own constructor. It now runs behind a beacon of its own, holds the vault beacon in storage, and is reached through a BeaconProxy whose address never moves across upgrades. Both beacons are Guardian-owned from inside their constructors.

retiredNote: Every address this project has ever deployed and replaced. Registering any of them with Flap would bind a token to superseded code. tools/check-docs.py reads this list, so a redeploy updates one file rather than a constant in the checker.

upgradeAuthority.LeverBeacon: owns the vault implementation; Flap Guardian
upgradeAuthority.LeverFactoryBeacon: owns the factory implementation; Flap Guardian
upgradeAuthority.note: Both beacons transfer ownership to the Guardian inside their own constructors, so the deployer never holds upgrade authority for a single block. Nothing else in this project has an owner, admin, or role of any kind.
